title: Finite type submodules of coherent modules are coherent; kernels of maps from finite type to coherent modules are of finite type (Stacks 01BY (1), (2))
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] (the statement and proof hold verbatim on any ringed space) and let *of finite type* and *coherent* $\mathcal O_X$-modules be as in [pqf-def-coherent], $\mathcal O_X$-modules and their morphisms as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. (1) If $\mathcal G$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module and $\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal G$ is a sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module (a subsheaf with $\mathcal K(U)$ an $\mathcal O_X(U)$-submodule of $\mathcal G(U)$ for every open $U\subseteq X$) which is of finite type, then $\mathcal K$ is coherent. (2) If $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ is a morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules with $\mathcal F$ of finite type and $\mathcal G$ coherent, then $\operatorname{Ker}\varphi$, the sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module $U\mapsto\ker(\varphi_U:\mathcal F(U)\to\mathcal G(U))$ of $\mathcal F$, is of finite type.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BY (label lemma-coherent-abelian, line 1641), parts (1) and (2) with the first two paragraphs of its proof (condition (2) of Definition 01BV holds for any subsheaf of a coherent sheaf; Ker(phi) is the image of K -> O_U^n -> F where K is the kernel of O_U^n -> G, e_i -> phi(s_i)); uses Lemma 01B7 (images of finite type modules). Tags verified in stacks-project/tags/tags: 01BY,modules-lemma-coherent-abelian; 01BV,modules-definition-coherent

proof.text: Conventions. For an open $U\subseteq X$, $\mathcal O_U=\mathcal O_X|_U$ and $\mathcal M|_U$ is the $\mathcal O_U$-module $W\mapsto\mathcal M(W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open), and $(U,\mathcal O_U)$ is a ringed space; every $\mathcal O_U$-linear map $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal M|_U$ is the map $e_i\mapsto s_i$ of the sections $s_i\in\mathcal M(U)$, the images of the basis sections $e_i$ [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. *Of finite type* is the condition of [pqf-def-coherent] (2), which is word for word condition (1) of [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]: every point has an open neighbourhood $V$ with an epimorphism $\mathcal O_V^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal M|_V$; we use it for $\mathcal O_X$-modules and for $\mathcal O_U$-modules on opens $U$. Kernels of morphisms of $\mathcal O_X$-modules are computed sectionwise [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; hence for a morphism $\alpha:\mathcal M\to\mathcal N$ and $U\subseteq X$ open, $(\operatorname{Ker}\alpha)|_U=\operatorname{Ker}(\alpha|_U)$ (both have sections $\ker\alpha_W$ over $W\subseteq U$), and $\operatorname{Ker}\alpha=0$ if every $\alpha_W$ is injective.

source.place: Modules, Definition 01BV (definition-coherent, line 1578) and Definition 01B5 (definition-finite-type); the conventions are used without statement in the proof of Lemma 01BY (lemma-coherent-abelian, line 1641)

proof.text: Part (1). Let $\iota:\mathcal K\to\mathcal G$ be the inclusion of the sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module, so every $\iota_W$ is injective. $\mathcal K$ is of finite type by hypothesis, which is the first clause of coherence, item (3) of [pqf-def-coherent]. For the second clause of item (3), let $U\subseteq X$ be open and $\psi:\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal K|_U$ an $\mathcal O_U$-linear map. Then $\iota|_U\circ\psi:\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal G|_U$ is an $\mathcal O_U$-linear map, and its kernel is of finite type because $\mathcal G$ is coherent (second clause of item (3) of [pqf-def-coherent] for $U$ and this map). For every open $W\subseteq U$, $\ker(\iota_W\circ\psi_W)=\ker\psi_W$ since $\iota_W$ is injective; kernels being sectionwise [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $\operatorname{Ker}(\iota|_U\circ\psi)=\operatorname{Ker}\psi$ as sub-$\mathcal O_U$-modules of $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}$. So $\operatorname{Ker}\psi$ is of finite type, and $\mathcal K$ is coherent.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BY (lemma-coherent-abelian, line 1641), proof, first paragraph: condition (2) of Definition 01BV holds for any subsheaf of a coherent sheaf

proof.text: Part (2), local setup. Let $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ be as in (2) and $x\in X$. Since $\mathcal F$ is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation] (1), there are an open $U\ni x$ and sections $s_1,\dots,s_n\in\mathcal F(U)$ whose map $\sigma:\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal F|_U$, $e_i\mapsto s_i$, is an epimorphism of $\mathcal O_U$-modules. Let $\psi=\varphi|_U\circ\sigma:\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal G|_U$, the map $e_i\mapsto\varphi_U(s_i)$. Since $\mathcal G$ is coherent, $\mathcal K:=\operatorname{Ker}\psi\subseteq\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}$ is an $\mathcal O_U$-module of finite type (second clause of item (3) of [pqf-def-coherent] for $U$ and $\psi$). For $W\subseteq U$ open and $a\in\mathcal K(W)$ we have $\varphi_W(\sigma_W(a))=\psi_W(a)=0$, so $\sigma_W(a)\in\ker\varphi_W=(\operatorname{Ker}\varphi)(W)$ (kernels are sectionwise, [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]); hence $\sigma$ restricts to an $\mathcal O_U$-linear map $\tau:\mathcal K\to(\operatorname{Ker}\varphi)|_U$, $\tau_W(a)=\sigma_W(a)$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BY (lemma-coherent-abelian, line 1641), proof, second paragraph: F|_U generated by s_1..s_n; the kernel K of O_U^n -> G, e_i -> phi(s_i), is of finite type by Definition 01BV

proof.text: Part (2), the induced kernel map is an epimorphism. Work in the abelian category of module sheaves on the open. For an epimorphism p : A -> B and f : B -> D, Mathlib CategoryTheory.epi_iff_surjective_up_to_refinements reduces epimorphy of kernel.map (p ≫ f) f p (identity D) to lifting a map z : Z -> kernel f after an epimorphic refinement. Apply surjective_up_to_refinements_of_epi to p and z followed by the kernel inclusion. This gives an epi q : Z' -> Z and a : Z' -> A with a ≫ p = q ≫ z ≫ kernel.ι f. Hence a ≫ p ≫ f = 0. Factor a through kernel (p ≫ f) by kernel.lift; cancellation of the monic kernel inclusion proves the desired lifting equality. Apply this to the finite free epimorphism of step 3.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BY (lemma-coherent-abelian, line 1641), proof, second paragraph: Ker(phi) is the image of the composition K -> O_U^n -> F (the equality of this image with Ker(phi)|_U is written out here by the agent)

proof.text: Part (2), finite type descends along an epimorphism: take finite local generating sections of its source, restrict the epimorphism to each member of the cover, and apply Mathlib SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.ofEpi to push the generators to the target. Their index types stay finite. Apply this to the kernel epimorphism of step 4, then transport across the isomorphism identifying the restricted kernel with the kernel of the restriction. Finally flatten the covering of coverings: index by pairs of outer and inner indices, use CoversTop.over for the cover and Over.iteratedSliceEquiv with SheafOfModules.pushforwardPushforwardEquivalence to transport the inner generating sections to restrictions on the original site. GeneratingSections.map and ofEpi preserve the finite index types. This supplies finite local generators globally, proving that kernel φ is of finite type.

split_report.summary: Split along Stacks Modules 01BY (lemma-coherent-abelian, line 1641), parts (1), (2), first two paragraphs of the proof. Checked pqf-def-coherent: its item (3) (coherent) is the 01BV condition (kernels of all maps O_U^n -> F|_U, every open U, of finite type), and its item (2) (finite type) is word for word def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation (1), which also gives that every map O_U^n -> M|_U is given by sections. Five steps: conventions (restriction, sectionwise kernels, elementary); part (1) by composing with the injective inclusion (elementary, from the definitions); part (2): local generators s_i, K = Ker(O_U^n -> G|_U) of finite type by coherence of G (elementary); K -> Ker(phi)|_U is an epimorphism by the local lifting criterion lem-weil-pbc-ringed-space-module-exactness-local-lifting (1) (the source's 'Ker(phi) is the image of K -> O_U^n -> F', written out); conclusion by lem-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-image-extension (1) on (U, O_U) and locality of the definition. No new node. Statement and stmt_deps kept. Mathlib: no coherent sheaves; searches added (leansearch, leanfinder, loogle, grep, local_search). Note: pqf-def-coherent cites tag 01DW, which is not the definition of coherent modules (01BV is).
